0022600106.text: The 76ers (2-0, 1st in the Atlantic and 1st in the East) host the Bucks (0-1, 4th in the Central and 1 game back, 13th in the East) in Philadelphia's third game of the season, with the home side riding a two-game winning streak. Philadelphia is without Ariel Hukporti (out, Achilles surgery), Dominick Barlow (out, back fracture), and Tacko Fall (out, quadriceps strain), while Dean Wade (ankle sprain) and LeBron James (back) are day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the 76ers won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 126-106 in Philadelphia on April 12, 2026.
